'''Ardeshir Hosseinpour'''<ref>Alternatively English [[transliterations]] of the Persian name are: Ardshir or Adreshire and Hassanpour or Hossein-pour</ref> ({{langx|fa|اردشير حسين‌پور}};&lrm; 1962 – 15 January 2007) was an [[Iranian peoples|Iranian]] [[Nuclear physics|nuclear scientist]], physics professor, and [[electromagnetism]] expert,<ref name="Melman">{{cite news|url=https://www.haaretz.com/hasen/spages/821634.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070206032005/http://haaretz.com/hasen/spages/821634.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=6 February 2007|title=U.S. website: Mossad killed Iranian nuclear physicist|access-date=5 February 2007|last=Melman|first=Yossi|author-link=Yossi Melman|date=4 February 2007|newspaper=Haaretz}}</ref> who was involved in the [[Nuclear program of Iran|Iranian nuclear program]].<ref name="Melman"/><ref name="AKI"/><ref name="times"/> He died mysteriously in early 2007 during his nuclear work at [[Isfahan]].

==Education and career==
Hosseinpour held a [[Bachelor of Science|B.S.]] degree in [[electrical engineering]] and a [[Master's degree|MSc]] degree in [[Nuclear Physics]] from [[Shiraz University]] in 2002.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://dbase.irandoc.ac.ir/00644/00644176.htm|script-title=fa:الکتروديناميک يون هاي مغناطيسي در ابرشبکه ها, /اردشير حسين پور|access-date=5 February 2007|date=4 January 2006|format=XML|publisher=IRANDOC Open Databases|language=Persian|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070208001814/http://dbase.irandoc.ac.ir/00644/00644176.htm |archive-date=8 February 2007}}</ref> He was a professor at [[Shiraz University]], and also taught at the [[Malek Ashtar University of Technology]] in Isfahan.

In 2005, he co-founded<ref name="stratfor">{{cite news|url=http://www.stratfor.com/products/premium/read_article.php?id=283793 |title=Geopolitical Diary: Israeli Covert Operations in Iran |access-date=4 February 2007 |date=2 February 2007 |publisher=[[Stratfor]] |url-status=dead |archive-url=http://arquivo.pt/wayback/20091010142626/http://www.stratfor.com/products/premium/read_article.php?id=283793 |archive-date=10 October 2009 }}(requires premium subscription)</ref> the [[Iranian nuclear program#Isfahan|Nuclear Technology Center]] of Isfahan,<ref name="AKI">{{cite news|url=http://www.adnki.com/index_2Level_English.php?cat=Security&loid=8.0.380293765|title=IRAN: NUCLEAR SCIENTIST DIES UNDER MYSTERIOUS CIRCUMSTANCES| access-date=5 February 2007|date=25 January 2007|publisher=Adnkronos International (AKI)}}{{Dead link|date=September 2010|bot=H3llBot}}</ref> where he continued his research until his death on 15 January 2007.

==Cause of death==
There are conflicting reports on the cause of Hosseinpour's death. It was not reported until six days later, first by ''Al-Quds'' (daily news) and then by the [[Iranian Students' News Agency]]. American [[Radio Farda]] (broadcasting in Persian) originally reported he had died due to "gassing".<ref name="radiofarda">{{cite news |url=http://www.radiofarda.com/Article/2007/01/21/f4_scientist_nuk_dies.html |title =مرگ مشکوک يک دانشمند هسته ای جمهوری اسلام (Scientist Nuk Dies) |access-date=2007-02-04|publisher=[[Radio Farda]]|language=Persian}}</ref>

The United States private intelligence company [[Stratfor]] released a report on 2 February 2007 claiming "sources very close to [[Israeli intelligence]]" had said that Hosseinpour was "a long time [[Mossad]] target", and that Hosseinpour died from "[[radioactive poisoning]]"<ref name="Melman" /> as part of a purported covert Mossad operation to halt the Iranian nuclear program.<ref name="times">{{cite news |url=http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/us_and_americas/article1324321.ece |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070208011223/http://www.timesonline.co.uk/tol/news/world/us_and_americas/article1324321.ece |url-status=dead |archive-date=8 February 2007 |title=Iranian nuclear scientist 'assassinated by Mossad' |access-date=2007-02-05 |last=Baxter |first=Sarah |date=2007-02-04 |work=[[The Sunday Times (UK)|The Sunday Times]] |location=London}} (refers to interview of [[Stratfor]]'s Rheva Bhalla)</ref><ref name="stratfor" /> It continued <blockquote>"Decapitating a hostile nuclear program by taking out key human assets is a tactic that has proven its effectiveness over the years, particularly in the case of Iraq. In the months leading up to the [[Operation Opera|1981 Israeli airstrike]] on Iraq's [[Osirak]] reactor—which was believed to be on the verge of producing plutonium for a weapons program -- at least three Iraqi nuclear scientists died under mysterious circumstances."<ref name="stratfor" /></blockquote>

The Israeli newspaper ''[[Haaretz]]'' reported that a "website of expatriate Iranian [[communist]]s" had claimed that several other scientists were killed and injured in the same incident.<ref name="Melman" />

Despite these reports, the "semi-official"<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.cnn.com/2007/WORLD/meast/01/26/iraq.main/index.html?eref=rss_topstories |title=U.S. troops allowed to kill Iranians plotting attacks in Iraq |access-date=2007-02-05 |publisher=[[CNN]]}}</ref> [[Fars News Agency]] reported that an unnamed informed source in [[Tehran]] told them Hosseinpour was not involved in the Isfahan nuclear facility, and that he "suffocated by fumes from a faulty gas fire in sleep."<ref>{{cite news|url=http://english.farsnews.com/newstext.php?nn=8511150571 |title=Moussad Incapable of Running Operations in Iran |access-date=2007-02-05 |date=2007-02-04 |publisher=[[Fars News Agency]] |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070209220338/http://english.farsnews.com/newstext.php?nn=8511150571 |archive-date=9 February 2007}}</ref> 

The report of an assassination was denied by [[Gholamreza Aghazadeh]], head of the [[Atomic Energy Organization of Iran]], who said that Iranian nuclear experts "are sound and safe."<ref>{{cite news |url=http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2007-02/05/content_5696356.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070208044030/http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2007-02/05/content_5696356.htm |url-status=dead |archive-date=8 February 2007 |title=Tehran denies reports on scientist's "assassination" |access-date=2007-02-05 |date=2007-02-05 |publisher=[[Xinhua News Agency]]}}</ref> Mossad sources, including former Mossad chief director [[Meir Amit]], also told the ''[[San Francisco Chronicle]]'' that the claim of assassination was "baseless" and "[went] against all known modus operandi of the agency."<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.sfgate.com/politics/article/israel-tense-over-the-iranian-threat-as-u-n-2616838.php |title=Israel tense over 'the Iranian threat' |access-date=2007-02-18 |last=Kalman |first=Matthew |date=2007-02-18|work=[[San Francisco Chronicle]] }}</ref>

According to an investigative work by an Italian journalist, Ardeshir Hosseinpour sympathised with [[Khatami]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Maurizi |first=Stefania |title=Il mistero della morte di mio marito che lavorava al nucleare iraniano |url=http://www.stefaniamaurizi.it/inchieste/hosseinpour.html |publisher=Il Venerdì of La Repubblica |language=Italian |date=2007-08-31 |access-date=2010-01-02 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110822013130/http://www.stefaniamaurizi.it/Inchieste/hosseinpour.html |archive-date=22 August 2011}}</ref> Ardeshir's sister, Mahboobeh Hosseinpour, claimed her brother was murdered by [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|Iran's Revolutionary Guards]] and not by Israel.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://nationalpost.com/news/israel-didnt-assassinate-iranian-physicist-in-2007-revolutionary-guard-did-sister-says|title=Israel didn't assassinate Iranian physicist in 2007 — Revolutionary Guard did, sister says|author=Felice Friedson, The Media Line|date=30 September 2014|work=National Post}}</ref>

In 2020, [[Mostafa Moeen]], the Minister of Culture and Higher Education under President [[Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani]] (1989-1993) and President [[Mohammad Khatami]] (1997-2000), asserted that Hosseinpour was killed by Mossad.<ref>{{cite news|url=
https://etemadonline.com/content/449370/%D9%BE%D9%86%D9%87%D8%A7%D9%86-%DA%A9%D8%A7%D8%B1%DB%8C-%D8%AF%DB%8C%DA%AF%D8%B1-%D8%AC%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%A8-%D9%86%D9%85%DB%8C-%D8%AF%D9%87%D8%AF-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%88%DB%8C%D8%B1
| title=تکذیب ترور دانشمندان برای زیرسوال نرفتن سیستم اطلاعاتی؟ / معین: پنهان‌کاری دیگر جواب نمی‌دهد! + عکس | newspaper=اعتمادآنلاین }}</ref>
